svg.title: 03 rcep
svg.text: Read the model before the colour

g.text: Each ratio compares an allocated export proxy with
model-implied exports. A lower value means less proxy
trade relative to the benchmark, not necessarily a
smaller market. Japan and New Zealand average 0.580
and 0.619; Thailand and the Philippines average 1.676 and
1.783. Below 0.8, the authors identify unused potential;
above 1.2, they suggest innovative trade models or new
New Zealand’s 2022 ratio is 0.83, above 0.8, although its
period average is below that threshold. A decade-wide
category can therefore hide later changes. Our
interpretation is that firms should compare both the
level and the time pattern, then investigate local demand,
payments and delivery. These historical model ratios can
help frame questions about a destination; they cannot
establish future sales or an effect of the RCEP
Source [4]: Zhang and Asraf bin Abdullah (2026), Table 19. Groups use 2013–2022 averages. RCEP: Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership. Bilateral exports are allocated proxies,
